description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different categories of knowledge as perceived by various language models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, which include Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis indicates the popularity, measured on a scale from 0 to 220. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different language model: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT. Additionally, there are four types of knowledge represented by different patterns on the bars: Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, Acc=1 & GT Ans, and Acc=1 & Gene Ans. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations. The chart does not include any legends or labels that indicate the exact values or trends in the data.
